[{"type":"RequirementTitle","content":"EMPHASIS COURSES","groupId":"eba87645-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":4,"area":"Requirements"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The CSU Bakersfield Music Program contributes to the musical, intellectual, and cultural environment of the university and surrounding region through programs of study and courses for music majors, minors, general education students, and liberal studies students; music electives for non-majors; and concerts, recitals, workshops, and festivals that provide performance opportunities for students and feature distinguished guest artists. The Bachelor of Arts in Music offers a robust undergraduate musical education set within a broader liberal arts curriculum.


For additional information visit the following:

Department of Music

Program Requirements - Music, BA, General Music Emphasis

Course Equivalency Information for 4-Year Institutions

Students and staff can explore course transfer equivalencies through the Transfer Evaluation System (TES). Equivalency agreements are updated regularly and subject to change. For the most current information, please refer to TES or contact the Articulation Office.
